title: feat(spec): a translation bundle may leave out apps.APP.label, so a module can translate only the navigation it contributes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBWJCAxocahVBk8inqe4qedH)_

Fixes #27086

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` › the app translation shape: `apps.APP.label` is now `z.string().optional()`, with a TSDoc saying why (a module bundle carries only the navigation ids it contributes into another package's app; the owner's label survives the runtime merge; requiring it made every module restate one package's string, and the last bundle merged won). The shape is shared, so this reaches `TranslationData`, `TranslationBundle`, `TranslationItem`, `PlatformTranslationData` and `ServedTranslationData`. `apps.APP.navigation.ID.label` stays required: it is the string being translated.
- New `packages/spec/src/system/translation-contributed-nav-bundle.test.ts`: the module-only bundle is annotated `TranslationData` / `TranslationBundle` (compiled by the package's test type-check, so the TS2741 is pinned), passes strict `defineStack`, and passes the bare `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` parse that `os validate` runs. Controls: a navigation entry with no `label` is still refused (schema issue path, plus a `@ts-expect-error` at the type); an app entry that authors its label keeps it.
- New `packages/cli/test/translation-contributed-nav-validate-door.test.ts`: spawns the source CLI, `os validate --json` on a module stack whose bundle is `apps.crm_enterprise.navigation.nav_case` only. Exit 0, `valid: true`. Control: the same stack with `nav_case: {}` exits 1 with the one issue at `translations.0.zh-CN.apps.crm_enterprise.navigation.nav_case.label`.
- `packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts` › `deepMerge`: a source key whose value is `undefined` is skipped. A bundle literal can spell the now-optional `apps.APP.label` as `label: undefined` (zod keeps the key), and when that bundle loaded after the owner's bundle it erased the owner's label (contract review ④.6).
- `packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.test.ts`: the runtime merge pin. An owner bundle and a label-less module bundle merge to the owner's label plus both navigation ids, in both load orders. The same holds for a module bundle whose label is present but `undefined`, in both load orders. Reverse check: without the `deepMerge` line, the owner-first `undefined` case fails (1 of 36).
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-contributed-nav-coverage.test.ts`: comment only. Its fixture note said a module could ship contributed labels only by restating the app label, which is no longer true.
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`: the `apps.{app}` row of the translation-key table now says `apps.{app}.label` may be left out under an app the stack only contributes into.
- `content/docs/references/**`: regenerated by `gen:docs` (`label` loses its required tick in `system/translation.mdx`; `api/protocol.mdx` shows `label?: string`).
- `.changeset/27086-module-bundle-contributed-nav.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor and `@objectstack/service-i18n` minor (its `src/**` moves under `Metadata-protocol: added`).

**Not changed, as ordered.** The runtime deep-merge (`FileI18nAdapter.loadTranslations` → `deepMerge`) is untouched. `os explain translation-target-unknown` is untouched: it already says that under an app a stack only contributes into, the contributed ids alone are accepted, and the schema now agrees with it.

**Moved counts:** none. No pinned count, ledger or baseline moved. `check:test-typecheck` for spec and cli held their debt ledgers unchanged (spec 52 files / 242 errors / 132 signatures, cli 3 / 28 / 6).

Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file teaches `apps.APP.label` as required. `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` lists the `apps` group's keys (label, description, navigation) and its examples author a label, both still valid.

## Why

HotCRM's module packages contribute navigation into the app package's `crm_enterprise` app. To keep each module self-contained (the ADR-0141 carve-out), each registers its own bundle carrying only `apps.crm_enterprise.navigation.<its ids>`. At run time that already works (deep-merge). At author time the required `apps.APP.label` refused it. Re-measured on main 72629f38 with a scratch probe: strict `defineStack` threw at `translations.0.zh-CN.apps.crm_enterprise.label`, the `os validate` parse failed at the same path, and `tsc` reported TS2741 "Property 'label' is missing" on a `TranslationData` literal.

## Verification

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

_Keep one value on each of the two lines above, each line starting with its key.
[Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum)
item 5 says what they mean._

Run on head 492b279a (branch off main 72629f38):
- Reverse check: with `translation.zod.ts` restored to 72629f38, the new spec file fails 3 of 4 (the two acceptance pins, and the nav-label control, which then lists the app-label issue too). With the fix, 4 of 4 pass.
- spec: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`, 741 files, 22,233 tests passed. `typecheck` (tsc, scripts, test layer) exit 0. `check:generated` exit 0 after `--fix` regenerated `content/docs/references/**` only.
- cli: the new door test and `i18n-contributed-nav-coverage.test.ts`, 2 files, 15 tests passed (after the `@objectstack/cli^...` closure build). `vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts` 22 passed. `typecheck` exit 0.
- service-i18n: `test` 4 files, 59 passed. `typecheck` exit 0.
- eslint on the five touched source and test files: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 107 commands, run serially. 104 exit 0, including `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` and `check:doc-authoring`. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone and passed (48 cases) after fetching its pinned fixture commit. `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-walk-parity` exited 3: they need a full repo build, so nothing was measured.
- Not done locally: main moved 11 commits after the branch point; none touches a file in this diff (only `email-template.zod.ts` under `packages/spec/src/system`), so main was not merged before opening. The dogfood battery and the full cli unit tier were not run.
- Round 2, head `4f17c024` (a merge of main `4265176c` via `os-regen-merge.sh`, with no conflicts and no regen changes): service-i18n test 4 files / 61 passed, typecheck exit 0, eslint exit 0; spec build + `check:generated` exit 0; new spec pin 4/4; `check-changeset-no-major` with the PR body as the event: LEVEL AXIS passes.
